framework.name: MITRE ATLAS
framework.description: Adversary tactics and techniques matrix for AI/ML systems.

threats.title: ML Supply Chain Compromise
threats.description: Malicious code injected into an external ML library or a backdoored model published on a public hub.
threats.attackVector: Developer downloads and deploys a poisoned model disguised as a popular tool.

threats.title: Prompt Injection
threats.description: Gaining influence over a chatbot or agent's behavior via crafted natural-language input.
threats.attackVector: Direct chat jailbreak or indirect injection via ingested content.

threats.title: Poison Training Data
threats.description: Imperceptible perturbations added to training images or text to plant a backdoor or bias.
threats.attackVector: Seeding a training set or RAG store with adversarially crafted samples.

threats.title: Adversarial Perturbation
threats.description: Input modified imperceptibly to humans but decision-flipping for the model.
threats.attackVector: A sticker on a stop sign fooling a self-driving car's classifier.

threats.title: Model Extraction
threats.description: Querying a commercial model millions of times to train a free clone of it.
threats.attackVector: Systematic API querying to reconstruct model behavior or weights.

threats.title: Denial of ML Service
threats.description: Overloading the GPU/TPU infrastructure serving a model to degrade it for legitimate users.
threats.attackVector: Flooding an inference endpoint with expensive, maximal-context requests.
